objective: Make My Bible reader-first with a searchable book/chapter/verse picker and replace the public bottom Connect slot with a Bible shortcut while preserving chat routing.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main source commit 54dae504382381173709e2be1883803b9a8abb3b; no Android Production OTA fingerprint or device behavior verified for this change.
chosenApproach: Re-use existing Bible reader data flow, offline caches, search, narration, and chapter selection; add a lightweight modal picker; route fourth nav slot to my_bible.
selectionRationale: Avoids rewriting the 5K-line reader or Bible data contracts, and leaves daily_plan/Connect services untouched.
alternativeApproaches: Full Bible reader rewrite (rejected: high regression risk)
New independent Bible reading route with duplicate state (rejected: breaks offline/narration continuity)
preserveBehaviors: Daily assigned reading completion/points path and reflections
Bible Search results open exact verse
Account-bound offline cache and ASD/KJV selection
Connect inbox, chat thread and notifications remain available at their existing routes
Wall remains the center/global default destination
acceptanceChecks: My Bible opens immediately at text with compact book/chapter/verse controls
Book modal filters by OT/NT and book name and chapter selection works
Verse can be selected or cleared to full chapter
Audio and text size controls remain reachable without occupying the default viewport
Bible in bottom nav opens my_bible even if currently in Daily Reading
